import pandas as pd

# List all source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_82/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_82/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_82/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_82/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_82/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_82/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_82/training_6.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_82/training_7.csv"
]

# Target schema columns
target_columns = ['created', 'screenname', 'followers', 'favourites', 'text']

# Read all source CSVs into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    # Read CSV with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    
    # Ensure columns are exactly as target schema (all source schemas are identical)
    # Just select the target columns to be safe
    df = df[target_columns]
    
    # Convert data types to match target schema:
    # 'created': string (keep as string)
    # 'screenname': string (keep as string)
    # 'followers': integer
    # 'favourites': integer
    # 'text': string (bytes represented as string, keep as is)
    
    # followers and favourites might be read as float if there are missing values, convert to int safely
    df['followers'] = pd.to_numeric(df['followers'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
    df['favourites'] = pd.to_numeric(df['favourites'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
    
    # Ensure 'created' and 'screenname' and 'text' are strings
    df['created'] = df['created'].astype(str)
    df['screenname'] = df['screenname'].astype(str)
    df['text'] = df['text'].astype(str)
    
    dfs.append(df)

# Since all source tables have the exact same schema as the target,
# we can union (concatenate) all source DataFrames vertically
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Write the combined DataFrame to the target CSV path
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_82/target_multisource_cot.csv", index=False)
